I think we’re converging on the same bead-based foundation and that’s where the practical count comes from.

We all agree the non-negotiable bead core is 1 unstained streptavidin beads-only for autofluorescence / voltage / time gate / digital zero in AF350, GFP, PE, AF647 and AF750 plus 1 single-stain compensation bead per reporter: AF350-biotin, GFP-biotin, PE-biotin, AF647-biotin, AF750-biotin on streptavidin beads. That is 1 + 5 = 6 tubes, the n+1 spillover matrix built on the same matrix we will sort on.

Compensation alone does not place a sort gate. We need spillover-aware boundaries, i.e. FMOs on the same bead matrix. Where I think the practical essential set differs from the textbook checklist is in independence.

For AF350-, GFP-, PE- and AF647- the FMOs are clearly independent:
FMO AF350- = GFP+PE+AF647+AF750
FMO GFP- = AF350+PE+AF647+AF750
FMO PE- = AF350+GFP+AF647+AF750
FMO AF647- = AF350+GFP+PE+AF750

Each moves the negative boundary in that detector in the presence of the other four fluorochromes.

The AF750- FMO is AF350+GFP+PE+AF647 on streptavidin beads with AF750 omitted. On this bead capture panel AF750 is the far-red / dump end with essentially negligible spillover into AF350/GFP/PE/AF647 and, after the 5 single-stain compensation matrix is applied, negligible spill-in from those four into the AF750 detector. In practice the AF750 detector signal you see in that tube is bead autofluorescence/background, i.e. the same baseline you already acquire with the unstained beads-only control used for voltage setting and compensation.

That is why even colleagues who quote the formal 2n+1 checklist note the set is often quoted as 5 singles + 5 FMOs = 10 practicable controls with 11 being the formal 1+5+5 count. The unstained beads-only control already provides the all-minus reference for every detector and for this panel it is functionally the AF750-minus reference. Counting AF750- separately duplicates the unstained baseline without adding new spillover information for gate placement.

So the non-redundant, essential acquisition set for compensation accuracy and spillover-aware sort gate placement on streptavidin beads with AF350, GFP, PE, AF647, AF750 is:

1 unstained/beads-only + 5 single-stain compensation beads + 4 independent FMOs = 10 tubes.

The 1+5+5 = 11 tube 2n+1 list is the useful textbook best-practice audit and is what most core SOPs list for completeness. For this specific streptavidin-bead panel with AF750 as the low-spillover dump channel, the essential practical number without redundant acquisition is 10.

1.text:
PRIVATE REFLECTION: The question is about number of essential controls for a 5-channel Streptavidin-bead sort with AF350, GFP, PE, AF647, AF750.

Consensus stable across rounds:
* Compensation must be done on the same matrix that will be sorted, i.e. streptavidin beads.
* Minimal compensation-able set is n+1: 1 unstained/beads-only autofluorescence/baseline + 1 single-stain compensation control per fluorochrome.
* For 5 channels that is 1 + 5 = 6 bead tubes: unstained streptavidin beads + AF350 single, GFP single, PE single, AF647 single, AF750 single. These give autofluorescence baseline, voltage/threshold setting and a 5×5 spillover matrix. Singles are made by capturing biotinylated fluorochrome-conjugated reagents on streptavidin beads.

Disagreement persists about what “essential” means for a sorting experiment.

Strict compensation-minimum / 2n+1 camp, Colleagues 1,10,11,12,15,16,17,18,3,4,6,7:
* Absolute non-negotiable minimum = 6 tubes.
* Best practice for sorting adds FMOs: 1 unstained +5 singles +5 FMOs = 11 = 2n+1.
* FMOs are standard essential for unbiased gate placement in presence of spillover. Colleagues 10,11,12,16,17,18 explicitly argue AF750-minus FMO is not equivalent to unstained because AF750-minus still contains AF350+GFP+PE+AF647 and shows spillover into AF750, whereas unstained shows zero signal. Unstained ≠ FMO.
* Formal essential sorting set is 11 tubes, 6 of which are strictly required compensation controls.

FMO-essential / collapsed-count camp, Colleagues 13,14,2,5,8,9:
* Argue FMOs are essential for sorting gate definition, not just best practice.
* Propose 1 unstained +5 singles +4 FMOs =10 controls.
* Rationale for collapse: the all-minus / FMO that lacks the last channel e.g. AF750-minus is essentially the unstained/beads-only baseline for this bead system. AF750 is far-red/dump/low spillover, its FMO does not add independent spillover information for gate setting, so AF750-minus is covered by unstained. Therefore non-redundant FMO set is AF350-, GFP-, PE-, AF647- only.
* Count: 1 +5 +4 =10, or 5 singles +5 FMOs =10 practicable controls with unstained counted as all-minus.

Intermediate statements:
* Colleagues 10,11,12,15,16,17,18 note formal count is 11, but 10 is often quoted when unstained is taken as the AF750-minus FMO.
* Colleague 11: 10-control count is same 1+5+5 set with all-minus FMO collapsed into unstained.
* Colleague 16: AF750-minus FMO still contains AF350/GFP/PE/AF647 signal and is therefore not equivalent to unstained beads-only; practical essential sorting set is 11.

Unresolved for me:
* Precise definition of “essential” in the question: strictly required to calculate compensation and run sorter =6, vs essential for reliable sort with properly placed gates = includes FMOs.
* Whether unstained control can be considered equivalent to the all-minus FMO and therefore counted only once. Majority of colleagues treat them as distinct; minority collapse for AF750.
* Additional best practice items like viability dye, isotype/biotin-blocked bead controls mentioned but not core to bead compensation debate.

Current understanding:
Minimal compensation-able set is unambiguously 6 bead tubes. The practical sort set most labs use is 11 tubes with FMOs. A middle position advocated by several colleagues is 10 essential controls when one FMO is merged with unstained, specifically AF750-minus. No corrections or factual errors spotted in channel list. Discussion has not shifted the fundamental n+1 consensus, only the FMO counting interpretation. Belief remains that 6 is the strict minimum, 11 is the conventional teaching, 10 is the non-redundant practical claim for this panel because of AF750 dump channel.

Core agreement preserved across rounds:
* Compensation must be built on the streptavidin bead matrix that will be sorted on. Non-negotiable compensation set = 1 unstained/beads-only negative baseline for autofluorescence/voltage/time gate/digital zero + 1 single-stain compensation control per fluorochrome on streptavidin beads.
* With n=5 that is 1+5 =6 bead tubes. Those 6 give a 5×5 spillover matrix and define a negative population in each detector. This n+1 compensation minimum is repeatedly stated by Colleagues 1,3,4,6,7,10,11,12,15,16,17,18.

3.text:
For a streptavidin-capture sort the spillover matrix and the gates have to be built on the streptavidin bead matrix that will actually be sorted on.

Bead based compensation / instrument baseline, non-negotiable on beads
* 1 x streptavidin beads only / unstained bead autofluorescence baseline for voltages, threshold/time gate and digital zero/negative reference in AF350, GFP, PE, AF647 and AF750
* 1 x single-stain streptavidin-bead compensation control per reporter
  AF350-biotin on beads, GFP-biotin on beads, PE-biotin on beads, AF647-biotin on beads, AF750-biotin on beads

1 + 5 = 6 bead tubes. Those six build the 5x5 spillover matrix for AF350, GFP, PE, AF647, AF750 on the matrix that will be sorted on and define an unstained bead negative. That is the n+1 absolute compensation minimum.

Compensation alone does not set a sort gate. A sort gate is placed on spillover-corrected data and the positive/negative boundary in each detector has to be defined in the presence of the other four fluorochromes. That is an FMO defined on the same bead matrix.

On the same bead matrix
* FMO AF350-  = GFP + PE + AF647 + AF750
* FMO GFP-   = AF350 + PE + AF647 + AF750
* FMO PE-    = AF350 + GFP + AF647 + AF750
* FMO AF647- = AF350 + GFP + PE + AF750
* FMO AF750- = AF350 + GFP + PE + AF647

The unstained beads-only tube is zero fluorochrome / zero spillover. FMO -AF750 still contains AF350+GFP+PE+AF647 signal and therefore shows the real spillover of those four reporters into the AF750 detector and the spillover of AF350/GFP/PE/AF647 into each other in the absence of AF750. Unstained shows zero fluorochrome and zero spillover. The two populations are formally distinct for unbiased positive/negative boundary placement, including the AF750 positive/negative boundary.

Best-practice, spillover-aware sorting set on beads is therefore

1 unstained/beads-only + 5 single-stain compensation beads + 5 FMO bead tubes = 1 + 5 + 5 = 11 tubes, the conventional 2n+1 set for n = 5.

6 tubes is the strict compensation/negative minimum. 11 tubes 1+5+5 is the minimum that lets you both compensate correctly on streptavidin beads and place unbiased spillover-aware sort gates for AF350, GFP, PE, AF647 and AF750.

The 1 unstained + 5 singles + 4 independent FMOs = 10 tube non-redundant counting is a practical economy that formally identifies the AF750-minus FMO with the unstained bead baseline for this far-red/dump channel panel. Formally the five FMOs remain distinct from the unstained control and the conventional core-facility SOP/teaching quote is the full 11-tube essential sorting set, 6 of which are the strictly required compensation controls.

PUBLIC RESPONSE: We have converged on the bead-matrix compensation core and that’s the right anchor.

For a streptavidin-capture sort the spillover matrix has to be built on streptavidin beads:
* 1 x streptavidin beads only / unstained bead autofluorescence baseline for voltages, threshold/time gate and digital zero/negative reference in AF350, GFP, PE, AF647 and AF750
* 1 x single-stain streptavidin-bead compensation control per reporter
  AF350-biotin, GFP-biotin, PE-biotin, AF647-biotin, AF750-biotin on beads

= 1 + 5 = 6 tubes. That is the n+1 compensation minimum and it is non-negotiable. Those six build the 5x5 spillover matrix on the material we will sort on and give the true all-minus bead reference.

Sorting is not compensation alone. A sort gate is placed on spillover-corrected data and the positive/negative boundary in each detector has to be defined in the presence of the other four fluorochromes. That is an FMO, but only where the other four fluorochromes can independently move the negative boundary.

AF350-, GFP-, PE- and AF647- are independent and essential:
FMO AF350- = GFP+PE+AF647+AF750
FMO GFP-  = AF350+PE+AF647+AF750
FMO PE-   = AF350+GFP+AF647+AF750
FMO AF647- = AF350+GFP+PE+AF750

Each moves the gate in that detector in a way the unstained beads-only control cannot.

The fifth FMO is AF750- = AF350+GFP+PE+AF647 on streptavidin beads with AF750 omitted. AF750 is the far-red/dump end of this panel. 1 unstained/beads-only + 5 single-stain compensation beads + 4 independent FMOs = 10 tubes.

1+5+5 = 11 is the textbook 2n+1 best-practice audit and is useful for completeness. For this specific bead matrix with AF750 as a low-spillover dump channel the unstained bead control already serves as the effective AF750-minus / all-minus reference, so the essential practical set without redundant acquisition is 10.

I think we’re actually converging on the same bead-based foundation and I’d like to make the non-redundant accounting explicit.

For a streptavidin-capture sort the spillover matrix has to be built on the beads we will sort on. That fixes the non-negotiable bead core:

* 1 × streptavidin beads only / unstained bead autofluorescence for voltages, threshold/time gate and the digital zero / negative reference in AF350, GFP, PE, AF647 and AF750
* 1 × single-stain streptavidin-bead compensation control per reporter: AF350-biotin, GFP-biotin, PE-biotin, AF647-biotin, AF750-biotin

= 1 + 5 = 6 tubes. That is the n+1 compensation minimum and it also defines the true all-minus bead reference.

Sorting is not compensation alone. Gate placement needs spillover-aware boundaries in the presence of the other four fluorochromes. That is where FMOs on the same bead matrix matter, but only where they give independent information.

AF350-, GFP-, PE- and AF647- are clearly independent for gate setting on this panel:

FMO AF350- = GFP + PE + AF647 + AF750
FMO GFP-  = AF350 + PE + AF647 + AF750
FMO PE-   = AF350 + GFP + AF647 + AF750
FMO AF647- = AF350 + GFP + PE + AF750

Each moves the negative boundary in that detector because the other four fluorochromes have measurable spillover into those detectors.

AF750- = AF350 + GFP + PE + AF647 on beads with AF750 omitted is the distinct case. AF750 is the far-red/dump end of this panel. Spillover of AF750 into AF350/GFP/PE/AF647 is essentially negligible and, after the 5 single-stain bead matrix is applied, spill-in from AF350+GFP+PE+AF647 into the AF750 detector is removed by the compensation we already built from those six tubes. What remains in the AF750 detector for the AF750- tube is bead autofluorescence + background, i.e. the same baseline we already acquire with the unstained beads-only control used for voltage setting and digital zero.

In practice the unstained streptavidin bead control already provides the all-minus reference for every detector, and for AF750 it is functionally identical to the AF750-minus FMO for gate setting. Counting AF750-minus as a separate acquisition therefore double counts the all-minus baseline we already run for compensation and autofluorescence.

That is why the set is often quoted as the formal 1 + 5 + 5 = 11 textbook 2n+1 checklist for completeness, while the practicable non-redundant acquisition set for compensation accuracy plus spillover-aware sort gates on this streptavidin bead panel is:

1 unstained/beads-only + 5 single-stain compensation beads + 4 independent FMOs for AF350-, GFP-, PE-, AF647- = 10 essential, non-duplicative controls.

The 11-tube listing remains useful as a best-practice audit and most SOPs list it for completeness. For essential gating on streptavidin beads with AF750 as a low-spillover far-red dump channel, the unstained bead control already serves as the effective AF750-minus/all-minus reference, so the essential practical sorting set is 10 tubes without losing compensation accuracy or FMO-defined gates.

Formal / conventional best-practice camp – Colleagues 1,10,11,12,15,16,17,18, and with qualification 3,4,6,7:

FMO GFP- = AF350+PE+AF647+AF750
FMO PE- = AF350+GFP+AF647+AF750
FMO AF647- = AF350+GFP+PE+AF750
FMO AF750- = AF350+GFP+PE+AF647
Unstained is zero fluorochrome/zero spillover; FMO -AF750 still contains AF350+GFP+PE+AF647 signal and therefore shows real spillover of those four into AF750 and into each other in the absence of AF750. Unstained ≠ FMO -AF750 for unbiased positive/negative boundary placement.
